items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Ann Cook. I saw a few monkey dogs. She's blind now.

ctx.x: Hi. Hi. You remember Ann Cook? Ann Cook? I reckon I do. Old Ann Cook. Is she living? Yes, she is.
Ann Cook. I saw a few monkey dogs. She's blind now. She's not there yet? Still on thing. Thank you, Mr. Perry. Did she sing much? Huh?
Did she do much singing? Did she sing? Uh-huh. Did you hear her sing? I don't know. I don't know.
